critic_scores.rationale: The claim that yes/no questions in Swedish are formed by adding 'nej' at the end is completely incorrect. In Swedish, yes/no questions (ja/nej-frågor) are formed through subject-verb inversion (V2 word order), where the verb moves to the first position and the subject follows — not by appending any particle. Additionally, 'nej' means 'no' in Swedish and has no grammatical role in question formation whatsoever.
critic_scores.improvement_tip: Replace the incorrect explanation with the accurate rule: Swedish yes/no questions are formed by inverting the subject and verb (e.g., 'Du talar svenska.' → 'Talar du svenska?'), which is the standard inversion rule used in Swedish grammar.
